environment.description: Same Flask application deployed behind an internal NLB (net/user-svc-nlb/a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8) in VPC vpc-0f9e8d7c6b5a4321. The NLB target group health check path is /health. Network access is enforced at the VPC level: the NLB resides in private subnets (10.128.64.0/22, 10.128.68.0/22) with no internet gateway route. Inbound traffic to the NLB listener (TCP/8080) is restricted by security group sg-0def456 which permits source CIDR blocks 10.128.0.0/20 (internal service mesh subnet) and 10.128.32.0/22 (CI/CD runner subnet) only. Additionally, VPC flow logs confirm no NAT gateway or VPC peering connection exists to any external-facing VPC. The only consumers are three registered ECS services (auth-resolver, session-manager, audit-logger) running in the 10.128.0.0/20 range with IAM task roles that have no internet egress path. Transit Gateway attachment tgw-attach-0x1y2z3 routes only RFC1918 prefixes.
